page.overview:
Who is Maerlina?

Maerlina was a former midwife who later came to run her own bathhouse in Novigrad. She had a unique gift that, on top of aging slowly, allowed her to heal many different ailments and find pockets of healing springs.

Many years ago, she lived in Vizima and served as the first midwife to Queen Adda of Temeria, but was unfortunate enough to witness the stillborn and the death of Adda. The two were buried in the royal crypt and for seven years, life went on, until the stillborn awoke as a striga, terrorizing the palace and causing it to be abandoned and the staff scattering to the winds. For Maerlina, despite having had a tryst with the courtier, Ostrit, that resulted in a pregnancy and two children, she decided to set out into the world to find more honest work.

Using her abilities to find healing springs, she soon made a name for herself among numerous settlements while she wandered the world. Eventually she learned in passing that Ostrit had died 7 years after she'd left Vizima, though it was unclear of the exact circumstances surrounding his death, leaving her to believe he possibly absconded to Pont Vanis instead.

Eventually, the Third Northern War broke out so she sent her two children, Elisa and Elid, to stay with her mother in Velen, believing they'd be safer there. However, this didn't go as planned and when she finally reunited with her children, she'd learned they'd been cursed by misdeeds of theirs and the villagers': her son could take on the form of a crow and her daughter had turned into a monster with only one singular goal in mind: revenge. With this, her daughter chose to hide for the most part outside Novigrad while Maerlina setup a successful bathhouse in the city itself and proclaimed she only had one child: Elid, who wasn't that bright. Due to her son's new ability, she also had to constantly reprimand him to not spy on those who were nude, like in the bathhouse.
